title: Pulse Dash
author: cobanov
description: A neon rhythm runner: your cube slides to a synthesized beat, and every spike, block, pad and ring sits on the music. Five levels from Easy to Insane, a practice mode with checkpoints, and one touch starts you again.

controls.D-pad: UP jumps, like A; LEFT / RIGHT choose a level; UP / DOWN choose in menus
controls.A: Jump (hold to keep jumping), jump again on rings; pick a menu entry, retry
controls.B: Back in menus, resume; title after a crash or a finished level
